scripts.lint:all: pnpm run workspace:check && pnpm run lint:eslint && pnpm run lint:style && pnpm run lint:rust
scripts.typecheck:ts: pnpm run workspace:check && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./tools/*" --fail-if-no-match --recursive --if-present run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm run typecheck:ts && pnpm run typecheck:rust
scripts.codegen:check: pnpm run workspace:check && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./tools/*" --fail-if-no-match --recursive --if-present run codegen:check && node tools/quality/generated-check.mjs
scripts.build:ts: pnpm run workspace:check && pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter "./apps/*" --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./tools/*" --fail-if-no-match --recursive --if-present run build
scripts.build:all: pnpm run codegen:check && pnpm run build:ts && pnpm run build:rust && node tools/quality/build-projection-check.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node tools/quality/run-warning-free.mjs -- pnpm run workspace:check && node tools/quality/run-warning-free.mjs -- pnpm --filter "./apps/*" --filter "./packages/*" --filter "./tools/*" --fail-if-no-match --recursive --if-present run test:unit
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:component && pnpm run test:e2e
